text: Rank memory in context by measured usefulness, not just similarity
description: Research cycle 2026-11-08 (Memory-Centric Continual Learning arXiv 2610.29357; MemRL; Modular Memory arXiv 2603.01761). The context compiler ranks reflections, cancelled lookalikes and dream memory by similarity today. Add a usefulness score per memory item: incremented when it was in context and the stage got a verified verdict, decremented when in context and the result failed. Rank by similarity x usefulness; items that never help sink out of the budget. Depends on traces and on the reflection-usefulness measurement.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude from the 2026-11-08 research cycle. Only worth it if the reflection-usefulness hypothesis holds.
